newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia rate cuts working through - Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia rate cuts working through - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Monday that recent cuts to official interest rates were still working through the economy.
"The interest rate reductions of the last 12 months are still working their way through the economy," Howard told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.
The Reserve Bank cut official cash rates 0.5 percentage points in each of four separate reductions starting in July 1996 to last month. Official cash rates now stand at 5.5 percent.
